era.title: ORBITAL
era.blurb: Air quotas, hull shifts, the long dark outside.

commands.name: RATION THE AIR
commands.text: Breath is metered by output. The slow breathe less.

commands.name: SEAL THE RING
commands.text: Bulkheads close at curfew. Each section alone with its fear.

commands.name: LOG EVERY HEARTBEAT
commands.text: Biometrics on the public board. Calm is mandatory.

commands.name: ROTATE THE HULL CREW
commands.text: Everyone takes the vacuum shift. Risk, fairly shared.

commands.name: PROMISE EARTH LEAVE
commands.text: A seat home for the best workers. Nobody has seen one used.

closing.synthesis: The station and its crew agreed on how much air a life needs.
closing.no_synthesis: The station kept spinning. Nobody chose the orbit.

era.image_scene: a rotating space station ring, airlock lights, cold steel and amber warning lamps
